notes: Instruction revised mid-session (coordinator message, b8893c7): switched from the time-limited override (lethal_root) to the proven-node design (lethal_proof off/root/root_reply), node-count cutoff, reachability trigger, unrestricted opponent replies. The early version was rewritten, not kept.

Deviation: the trigger was extended from own MAIN to own effect dialogs in own turn (v2). With MAIN only (v1), the search decided the dialogs inside a proven line differently and threw away wins (seed 3012154 p2 t14). v1 results are kept in n1_results/lethal_root/v1_main_only/. Arena games were identical between v1 and v2 on both bands.

Validation could not use the audit's own 1,000 boards: replaying the same seeds on today's code diverges (same move at 1 of 75 audit points), so the 200+200 points were drawn from the 300-game redo, where each point carries both the audit judge (true deal) and the Rust judge (fair deals). Non-otsu sample = ko_only and none points (unknown audit points excluded).
The audit judge itself has false negatives (28 of 47 'Rust win, audit no' points were actually won that turn; its TT key is the hidden JSON which lacks per-turn ability usage / continuous effects).

Soundness caveats: proof = all 8 sampled fair deals, not all deals (19 of 993 proven points not won); later own decisions may differ per deal (not a single strategy over the information set); root_reply builds reply states with apply_move_inplace which default-drains the opponent's follow-up dialogs; opponent ARRANGE_DECK of 2+ cards and >64 selection combos abort the proof.

Defensive deals rank by counter value (+500 for counter events, blocker keyword as a tie-break); hand blockers cannot defend this turn, so the blocker bonus is only ordering. Life triggers are not ranked (left to the random fair deals).

Value of a proven-lost reply child is -1 in the engine's [-1,1] scale (= win prob 0 for the opponent). Proven children are removed from the reply node (the battle box chooses among the rest); only if all are proven are all children fixed at -1. Win propagation (all children lost => parent lost) not implemented, per spec.
Reply budget 40,000 per decision is split evenly across worlds (deterministic under threads).
The trigger is loose: 87% of own MAIN points (danger words are common), so the root judge runs almost everywhere; 30% of judged points hit the 20,000-node cap.

kind='lethal' decisions carry no N/Q statistics; record_gen maps unknown kinds to 0 (main) but writes no policy row (groups empty), so the proven move would not reach the policy teacher as-is if lethal_proof is enabled in generation.
Added arena_shard --worlds (baseline seat worlds) to run both seats at the shipping setting (2 worlds x 1,280 sims).

Off-vs-off on the same seeds is deterministic and reproduces the candidate's score where nothing changed (43/80 and 34/80): recommend running it alongside the production arena to read only the changed games.
